_README: THE FOURTH REMINDER CHANNEL: the reminder text PRINTED ON THE CARD'S TYPE LINE, which the oracle transcription
(data/cards/AlgomancyCards-OracleText.json) does not carry. The oracle's `text` field holds only the text box, and its
{i}(…) italics are the text-box reminders (Wisps, Poison, …); an attribute's reminder sits under the type line on the
card and was never transcribed. So on 2026-09-05 the rules panel said 'no card prints a reminder for this attribute'
about ten attributes whose cards literally print one — the owner: 'The cards that have those effects LITERALLY are
printed with reminder text on them.' These were read off the scans in data/cards/ by eye, one card per attribute,
and are verbatim including the wording the engine's own glossary paraphrased differently.
Add a row here only after reading the scan. `card` is the scan it was read from.

source.authority: the printed card, above every transcription

Sneaky.text: Sneaky units can't be blocked if attacking alone.

Alluring.text: When an alluring column attacks, target enemy can't attack and must block it this combat if able.

Tough.text: Tough units have their defense doubled.

Resonant.text: Whenever a resonant source deals damage to a unit, it deals that much damage to that unit's controller.

Thieving.text: Whenever a thieving source deals combat damage to an opponent, draw a card.

Reaping.text: When a reaping source kills one or more units, draw a card. It loses reaping until regroup.

Unaware.text: Unaware cards and units they are interacting with ignore all stat changes.
